judgements.justification: Neither committee had a detractor to set aside; all seven final ratings are 7.
No reviewer or area chair on either committee raised audience breadth or venue fit.
B's meta-review names only the SQ result but misreports no reviewer position or rebuttal, and A's 'All reviewers and the AC like the paper' is accurate.
Silent reviewers sat on both committees, but no score awaited revision: B had no doubt to settle, and A's one doubter (Pvqb) replied and moved to 7.
B's Gr4i could not judge novelty and still rated 7, but every reviewer on both committees rated 7 unchecked, so his score lifted neither mean nor tier above the checked assessments.
Neither committee split; all seven reviewers rated 7.
A got fuller answers and B one general reply, but the notes show no conflicting accounts, numbers or one-sided concessions.
Gdae's uncited Malach et al. pointer did not change his 7, and no novelty verdict rested on a wrong account of prior work.
B's spotlight goes beyond three 7s, and its meta-review ('a solid work worthy of acceptance') argues only for acceptance, giving no reason for the higher tier.
No reviewer objected to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises.
No reviewer on either committee rated above 7 or argued for a highlight.
Neither committee judged the promised revisions too large for camera-ready.
Neither record shows an off-record assessment; the notes only guess that the spotlight may be the AC's or SAC's call.
Both committees accepted the lack of practical relevance as inherent to a theory paper and applied no extra standard.
No below-threshold score remained after the rebuttal; Pvqb moved from 6 to 7.
